description: 白后孤军深入b7成困子，被迫换车
explanation_en: Black's knight attacks the deeply advanced queen, leaving it with only one escape: capture the rook on a8. Black's queen then recaptures, winning a rook for the queen.

intro.popup: 💡 困子：白后孤军深入到b7！黑方如何利用马和车配合，将白后困死并赢得子力？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Trapped piece: White's queen has ventured alone to b7. How can Black coordinate the knight and rook to trap it and win material?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Nc5攻后→Qxa8是唯一逃路→黑后Qxa8赢回！白后深入被困，以后换车损失惨重。开局切忌后孤军深入！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Nc5 attacks the queen. Its only escape is Qxa8, after which Black recaptures with Qxa8 and wins a rook. Avoid sending the queen deep into enemy territory without support.

moves.popup: 黑马Nc5！马从a6跳到c5，直接攻击白后b7。白后b7被马攻击，退路极为有限！
moves.popup_en: Black's knight jumps from a6 to c5, attacking White's queen on b7 and severely limiting its escape squares.

moves.popup: 白后被迫Qxa8！只能去吃黑车a8，别无出路（b8、c8、c7、b6等都被黑方棋子控制）。这是丢后的困境。
moves.popup_en: White's queen is forced to capture the rook on a8; its other escape squares are controlled by Black. The queen is trapped and lost.

moves.popup: 黑后Qxa8！黑后从d8取回白后，黑方以后换后+车，净赚一车。白方后深入代价惨重！
moves.popup_en: Black's queen recaptures on a8. Black has exchanged queens and won a rook; White's unsupported queen excursion has proved costly.
